pin_note: Both pins are accepted. Accepting the v0.2.1 pin is additive: an input that verified under the v0.2.0 pin before this change verifies identically after it, and an input offered with any unpinned schema still fails the schema_digest verdict. No pre-existing pass/fail disposition moves.

pins.role: Verifies historical v0.2.0-era receipts. Retained unchanged; its bytes are untouched by this lane.
Adds the optional subject_ref_origin property with exact-membership rejection over the closed five-value vocabulary. Differs from v0.2.0 only in $id, title, and that property.

byte_identity_note: arcs_verify/data/srs-envelope-v0.2.1.schema.json and vendor/arcs-srs/schemas/srs-envelope/v0.2.1/srs-envelope.schema.json are byte-identical to the arcs-srs merge commit named above and hash to the pinned sha256.
published_version_note: published_version in the vendored envelope manifest is pre-release artifact metadata. It names a manifested pre-release envelope artifact version and is not evidence that a public SRS release occurred.
receipt_version_note: receipt_version srs.core.v5.1 is an internal pre-public-release compatibility value. It is unchanged by this lane and is not a public, current-public, or forward public identifier.

vector_set.note: Unsigned envelope vectors. They pin origin-reading behavior only and prove nothing about signing; the signed vector sets remain the authority for that.
